propositions: Six process recommendations from the 2026-08-15 frozen audit require evaluation against prior decisions, janitor work, and implementation outcomes to determine reaffirm/refine/reconsider/defer disposition with explicit rationale.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was already implemented as fail-open optional capture at creation seams in evadible-ambitious-canary; coverage remains low (1.1%) but implementation worked; refine by expanding automated stamping at known filer/agent boundaries and measuring post-rollout coverage by creation_channel.

Deterministic plan preflight floor exists at P1-P11 (not P1-P8); prior blockers reject spec-by-example and riskiest-assumption criteria that do not discriminate; extend only for recurrent mechanically decidable failures demonstrated in replay against pass/block cohorts with fail-open behavior.

Completion-failure classification requires offline historical analysis to distinguish code defects from unmet ACs, missing evidence, scope gaps, and tool failures before adding schema; 351 failure sidecars already carry structured findings with criterion, dimension, severity, and remediation.

Risk-tiered review must pilot reporting without merge enforcement; signals include security/store/concurrency surfaces, planned impact, module complexity, and plan-review failures; measurement must precede threshold selection, and autonomous governance eliminates human-override requirement.

Proactive debt management: the 720 LOC soft warning already shipped in Gerrit change 1751; do not adopt arbitrary quota targets; prioritize debt only where near-cap size intersects complexity, churn, duplication, defects, or centrality; verify metric health independently.
